title: Kinds and grades of faith
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Historical faith knows and assents toward Gospel history without trust; temporary faith sprouts on rocky ground and withers under persecution; miraculous faith credits divine power for wonders. Justifying faith alone saves: knowledge, assent, and trust in Christ ye mediator, apprehending ye Gospel promise unto justification and eternal life. — Faith stands as distinguished as historical, dogmatic, temporary, miraculous, and justifying or saving faith.
pass_b_english: Faith is distinguished as historical, dogmatic, temporary, miraculous, and justifying or saving faith.

Historical faith knows and assents to Gospel history without trust; temporary faith sprouts on rocky ground and withers under persecution; miraculous faith credits divine power for wonders. Justifying faith alone saves: knowledge, assent, and trust in Christ the mediator, apprehending the Gospel promise unto justification and eternal life.
source_text: Distinguenda est fides historica, dogmatica, temporalis, miraculosa, et fides iustificans seu salvifica. Fides historica est notitia et assensus historiae Evangelicae sine fiducia. Temporalis germinat in petrosis et aestu persecutionis arescit. Miraculosa credit potentiae divinae ad mira. Fides iustificans sola salvat: notitia, assensus, fiducia in Christum mediatorem, apprehendens promissionem Euangelii ad iustificationem et vitam aeternam.
